message: We've all had those moments where we realize we're just not ready for a blackout—like when you find yourself rummaging through drawers for a flashlight that isn't even working. I came across a great resource that breaks down what to do during power outages, and it’s a handy reminder to keep a few essentials on hand. It's all about being prepared in a light-hearted way, so we can embrace the dark with a little more confidence. What’s your favorite go-to item when the lights go out?
